'''Beryl''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] scout of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Stationed at the [[Kri-Ta Outpost]] in the [[Pelath-Ri Marches]], he discovered a [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] plan to use artillery to target the [[Shrine of Healing]] and asked a Republic hero to put a stop to it.
